selection: Every historical difference in the committed, cleaned03 audit. The cohort is Mesh-LOAM only. Diagnostic parameters transfer unchanged from02/01; no registration setting is selected and no estimator is rerun.

position_error: First-pose-normalized estimated position versus the same evaluated GT; no fitted alignment or rescaling.
paired_gap: Euclidean position difference between first-pose-normalized historical and current estimates. Rank inherited fixed blocks by gap at end minus gap at start; retain every block and every frame.
limits: Pair only available committed historical trajectories with byte-identical evaluated GT. Exact-path and reachable-history probes describe this checkout, not global absence. Record Mesh historical/current runtime and core identity; differing thread counts are a confound, not a cause.
